mostWorthwhile.text: Following rain as it evaporated and recycled through the sky made clear that water can persist on the planet without immediately forming an ocean.

leastWorthwhile.text: The repeated cooling and recycling steps felt drawn out, especially when only one combination was offered.

surprise.text: Rain returned as steam even though an earlier step had established ground cool enough to retain water. The distinction between local cool ground and the hot surface was somewhat confusing.

arbitrary.text: Combining rain with the original volcanic surface after cooling the atmosphere felt unclear: the already-cooled ground was not an option for that step.

continue.text: I would be curious to continue to see how water accumulates into a sea, though I would hope for fewer repeated, forced steps.
